limits: No original game/room is present; no engine physics, runtime material, CPU/GPU performance, installed species/body accessibility or load/food certification.
Hull boundary error includes internal section faces, so its conservative upper bound also bounds the compound exterior; inward/source omission is assessed separately by whole-triangle containment.
The 25mm sphere is a bounded service-object/hand proxy only. Reported rectangles exclude actual support, end bulkhead, shelf and drawer volumes.

All source surfaces represented by the baseline are retained conservatively; old whole-fascia overfill is intentionally removed with five vertical profile bands. Decorative ribs, reveal and drawer grip remain intentionally absent from collisions, as in Batch07.

Surface error is sampled on a <=25mm triangular net with its explicit covering-radius upper bound. Distances include inherited per-profile convexification; new arc chord bound is5mm and profile-depth bound5mm.
Contact within1 micrometre is allowed in the continuous drawer proposal test. This is geometric separation, not joint/controller or mechanical certification.
